get.description: Exchanges client credentials for a temporary bearer token.

401.description: Authentication failed due to invalid appId or appSecret.

post.description: Creates a new classification entry for categorizing teams.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all team classifications available in the system.

patch.description: Updates an existing team classification entry identified by its ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a team classification from the system.

post.summary: Complete a multipart upload to S3

201.description: Presigned URL for part generated successfully.

get.summary: Get the Game Recap Game Box Score for a specific Game.
get.description: Retrieves full game box score stats for both teams and players for a specific game.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the Game Recap Game Box Score

get.summary: Get the Game Recap Score for a specific Game.
get.description: Retrieves the final score and the score breakdown by quarter and overtime periods for both the home and away teams.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the Game Recap Score.

get.summary: Get the Game Recap Scoring Summary for a specific Game.
get.description: Retrieves a chronological list of all scoring plays for a specific game, including details about the play, the drive, and the resulting score.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the Game Recap Scoring Summary

get.summary: Get the Game Recap Scoring Summary Pro for a specific Game.
get.description: Retrieves the full pro scoring summary for a specific game with drive context and players involved for each scoring play.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the Game Recap Scoring Summary Pro

get.summary: Get the Game Recap Team Stats for a specific Game.
get.description: Retrieves a detailed statistical breakdown for both the home and away teams, covering offense, defense, and special teams performance.

200.description: a detailed statistical breakdown for both teams

post.description: Creates a new mascot record with a name and description. An optional mascot image can be uploaded as part of the multipart form data.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all mascots. Supports searching by name and pagination through query parameters.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing mascot identified by its ID. Allows updating the name, description, and mascot image.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a mascot record from the system.

get.description: Retrieves the complete metadata for a single play clip by its unique ID.

200.description: Successful retrieval of play clip details

post.description: Registers a new team in the system, including its name, short name, sport, mascots, classification.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all teams belonging to the client. Supports filters for search, sport, and state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of results to skip for pagination.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a team record from the system.

patch.description: Updates the details of an existing team identified by its ID. Allows updating the name, short name, coach, logo, and other details.

get.summary: Get a presigned URL for a specific part of a multipart upload

200.description: Presigned URL for part generated successfully.

post.description: Registers a new venue where games are held, including details about the venue name and location.

patch.description: Updates the information of an existing venue currently registered in the system.

delete.description: Permanently removes a venue registration from the system.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all venues where sports events or games are conducted.

info.title: Victory Code Client API
info.description: Client APIs for Tactix partners: authenticate, upload game video, and retrieve games, plays, game recaps and team metadata.

season.description: Four-digit year of the game, 1900-2099. Derive it from the game date in the local timezone of the user; spans such as "2023-24" are rejected.

mascots.description: Array of Mascot IDs (must not be empty)

sacks.description: SACKS — may be fractional (0.5 for shared sack)
SACKS — may be fractional (0.5 for shared sack)

gameTitle.example: Green Bay Packers vs Philadelphia Eagles

longFieldGoal.description: LONG — longest made field goal in yards
LONG — longest made field goal in yards

description.example: A fierce tiger ready to pounce on the opponent.

qbr.description: ESPN QBR — null when not supplied
ESPN QBR — null when not supplied

accessToken.description: The bearer token used for subsequent API requests.

expiresIn.description: The duration of the token validity in seconds.
